SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS OnTimeSKey,
year as [Year],
month as [Month],
FL_DATE as FlightDate,
OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER as AirlineCode,
OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID as AirlineId,
OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM as FlightNumber,
ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID as OriginAirportId,
ORIGIN as OriginAirportCode,
ORIGIN_STATE_ABR as OriginStateCode,
DEST_AIRPORT_ID as DestinationAirportId,
DEST as DestinationAirportCode,
DEST_STATE_ABR as DestinationStateCode,
CRS_DEP_TIME as ScheduledDepartureTimeKey,
DEP_TIME as ActualDepartureTimeKey,
DEP_DELAY as DepartureDelayInMinutes,
TAXI_OUT as TaxiOutTimeInMinutes,
TAXI_IN as TaxiInTimeInMinutes,
CRS_ARR_TIME as ScheduledArrivalTimeKey,
ARR_TIME as ActualArrivalTimeKey,
ARR_DELAY as ArrivalDelayInMinutes,
CANCELLED as IsCancelled,
CANCELLATION_CODE as CancellationCode,
DIVERTED as IsDiverted,
CRS_ELAPSED_TIME as EstimatedElapsedTimeInMinutes,
ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME as ActualElapsedTimeInMinutes,
ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME - CRS_ELAPSED_TIME as TotalDelayInMinutes,
AIR_TIME as AirTime,
DISTANCE as Distance,
CARRIER_DELAY as AirlinesDelayInMinutes,
WEATHER_DELAY as WeatherDelayInMinutes,
NAS_DELAY as NasDelayInMinutes,
SECURITY_DELAY as SecurityDelayInMinutes,
LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY as LateAircraftDelayInMinutes
FROM 
silver.vw_USOnTimeData
WHERE year ='2022' and month='01'
ORDER BY OnTimeSKey




SELECT TOP 10 OTD.FL_DATE as FlightDate,
OTD.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER as AirlineCode,
AL.Description as AirlinesName,
OTD.OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM as FlightNumber,
OTD.ORIGIN as OriginAirportCode,
APO.Description as OriginAirportName,
OTD.ORIGIN_STATE_ABR as OriginStateCode,
SO.Description as OriginState,
OTD.DEST as DestinationAirportCode,
APD.Description as DestinationAirportName,
OTD.DEST_STATE_ABR as DestinationStateCode,
SD.Description as DestinationState,
TDS.TimeValue as ScheduledDepartureTime,
TDS.TimeBucket as DepartureTimeBucket,
TDA.TimeValue as ActualDepartureTime
FROM
silver.vw_USOnTimeData OTD
LEFT JOIN silver.Airlines AL ON OTD.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER = AL.Code
LEFT JOIN silver.Airport APO ON OTD.ORIGIN = APO.Code
LEFT JOIN silver.States SO ON OTD.ORIGIN_STATE_ABR = SO.Code
LEFT JOIN silver.Airport APD ON OTD.DEST = APD.Code
LEFT JOIN silver.States SD ON OTD.DEST_STATE_ABR = SD.Code
LEFT JOIN silver.Time TDS ON OTD.CRS_DEP_TIME = TDS.TimeKey
LEFT JOIN silver.Time TDA ON OTD.CRS_DEP_TIME = TDA.TimeKey
LEFT JOIN silver.Time TAS ON OTD.CRS_DEP_TIME = TAS.TimeKey
LEFT JOIN silver.Time TAA ON OTD.CRS_DEP_TIME = TAA.TimeKey



SELECT
    OTD.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER as AirlineCode,
    AL.Description as AirlinesName,
    SUM(CANCELLED) as TotalCancelledFlights,
    SUM(DIVERTED) as TotalDivertedFlights,
    COUNT(OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM) AS TotalScheduledFlights,
    CAST(CAST(SUM(CANCELLED) AS DECIMAL(10,2))/CAST(COUNT(OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) *100 as DECIMAL(10,2)) as CancelledPercentage,
    CAST(CAST(SUM(DIVERTED) AS DECIMAL(10,2))/CAST(COUNT(OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) *100 as DECIMAL(10,2)) as DivertedPercentage
FROM
    silver.vw_USOnTimeData OTD
    LEFT JOIN silver.Airlines AL ON OTD.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER = AL.Code
WHERE
    OTD.year='2022' AND OTD.month ='01'
GROUP BY
    OTD.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER,
    AL.Description
ORDER BY AirlineCode
